description: This file implements the HandleBusMessage class, which processes GStreamer bus messages such as state changes, end-of-stream, QoS, and errors, for a media playback pipeline within the Rialto server. It handles notifications to clients and manages pipeline state transitions.

classes.name: HandleBusMessage
classes.description: A class responsible for handling GStreamer bus messages, updating playback state, notifying clients, and managing pipeline events.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Processes the current GStreamer message, handling different message types such as state changes, EOS, QoS, and errors, and performs appropriate actions including client notifications and logging.

methods.name: allSourcesEos
methods.description: Checks whether all media streams have reached end-of-stream based on the current context.
